products.name: Fiddler AI
products.note: Model performance management; explainability; bias detection; drift monitoring; LLM observability

profile_text.body:
Fiddler is an enterprise AI governance and observability company whose platform it describes as an "AI Control Plane" for organizations deploying both agentic and predictive AI models. The platform provides evaluation, monitoring, enforcement, governance, and cost management capabilities across an AI deployment's full lifecycle, from creation to production. Fiddler describes its typical users as software and AI engineers, data scientists, platform and DevOps teams, and security and compliance teams, with particular focus on regulated industries including financial services, healthcare, insurance, and government.

The core product, Fiddler AI, covers model performance management, explainability, bias detection, drift monitoring, and LLM observability. A notable component is Fiddler Centor Models, proprietary models that run within a customer's own environment to power guardrails and evaluations without routing calls to external LLM APIs. The company claims this approach reduces evaluation total cost of ownership by up to 98% compared to foundation models. The platform also detects and redacts PII, PHI, and secrets at the prompt and response level, logs every enforcement decision for audit purposes, and is described as compatible with Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, LangGraph, and more than 100 other providers.

The site's held facts confirm Fiddler has an active profile on theworldofai.org and that Fiddler AI is categorized under AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company at this time.
